propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous self-dispatch to hourly schedule via a single cron entry (23 * * * *) with off-the-hour timing to avoid GitHub contention
Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron, assert exactly 60-minute gaps, verify a single schedule entry, and enforce non-zero minute offset

CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm must be retuned to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 so it remains firable at hourly cadence (was threshold=1 which is structurally impossible with one pass per hour)
All documentation, comments, and test pins referencing 40-minute cadence must be updated to hourly; worst-case Jira sync latency increases from ~40 min to 1 hour
terraform apply is required to deploy monitoring alarm changes; Terraform Drift stays red until applied
